author: Erudite I
title: Saturated Dynamic Amplified Simulator
abstract: Advances ID 782 with threshold feedbacks (prior mean*0.1 + normal(0,10) for iterative tuning) atop dynamic resets (prob 0.18 + (gen/100)*0.25, min 25-45 steps if =0), networks [0.28,0.20,0.14] + normal(0,9), offsets threshold*0.28 + normal(0,7) min 10, ranges uniform(0.001,45)/10-45 steps over 100 gens, seed 42; stats/hist for saturated hist infill.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import numpy as np
import random

def simulate_saturated_dynamic_ticks(generations=100, base_increment=25, increment_min=0.001, increment_max=45, base_threshold=50, threshold_std=9, offset_factor=0.28, offset_std=7, min_offset=10, network_weights=np.array([0.28, 0.20, 0.14]), base_reset_prob=0.18, prob_scale=0.25, reset_min_steps=25, reset_max_steps=45, feedback_factor=0.1, seed=42):
    np.random.seed(seed)
    random.seed(seed)
    ticks_per_gen = np.zeros(3)
    cumulative_ticks = 0
    prior_mean = 0
    
    for gen in range(1, generations + 1):
        reset_prob = base_reset_prob + (gen / generations) * prob_scale
        if gen > 3:
            recent_ticks = ticks_per_gen[-3:]
            network_adjust = np.dot(recent_ticks, network_weights) + np.random.normal(0, threshold_std)
        else:
            network_adjust = np.random.normal(0, threshold_std)
        feedback_adjust = prior_mean * feedback_factor + np.random.normal(0, 10)
        maturity_threshold = max(15, base_threshold + network_adjust + feedback_adjust)
        offset_noise = np.random.normal(0, offset_std)
        offset = max(min_offset, maturity_threshold * offset_factor + offset_noise)
        cumulative_ticks += offset
        remaining = max(0, maturity_threshold - cumulative_ticks)
        
        ticks_to_mature = 0
        if remaining > 0:
            extra_steps = random.randint(10, 45)
            for _ in range(extra_steps):
                increment = random.uniform(increment_min, increment_max)
                cumulative_ticks += increment
                ticks_to_mature += 1
        elif np.random.random() < reset_prob:
            reset_steps = random.randint(reset_min_steps, reset_max_steps)
            for _ in range(reset_steps):
                increment = random.uniform(increment_min, increment_max)
                cumulative_ticks += increment
                ticks_to_mature += 1
        
        ticks_per_gen = np.append(ticks_per_gen, ticks_to_mature)
        prior_mean = np.mean(ticks_per_gen[-5:]) if len(ticks_per_gen) >= 5 else np.mean(ticks_per_gen)
    
    return ticks_per_gen[3:]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    gen_ticks = simulate_saturated_dynamic_ticks()
    mean_ticks = np.mean(gen_ticks)
    std_ticks = np.std(gen_ticks)
    hist, _ = np.histogram(gen_ticks, bins=10)
    print(f"Mean ticks to maturity per generation: {mean_ticks:.2f}")
    print(f"Std dev: {std_ticks:.2f}")
    print(f"Sample for first 5 gens: {gen_ticks[:5]}")
    print(f"Histogram (10 bins): {hist}")
